name: Zendesk Ticket Assistant
summary: Classify incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team, draft replies for simple ones, and escalate VIP tickets.

items.title: Incoming Zendesk tickets
items.description: Reads new incoming tickets from Zendesk as they arrive.
items.proved_when: New support tickets appear in the app queue automatically.

items.title: Ticket classifier and router
items.description: Classifies incoming tickets by urgency level and assigns them to the correct team.
items.proved_when: Tickets in the list display assigned urgency and team labels.
items.source_quote: Classify incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team

items.title: Simple reply drafter
items.description: Drafts polite response messages for simple tickets automatically.
items.proved_when: A draft reply is generated and attached to simple tickets.
items.source_quote: draft a reply for simple ones

items.title: VIP ticket escalator
items.description: Detects tickets from VIP customers and flags them for immediate human escalation.
items.proved_when: Tickets from recognized VIP customers are marked as high priority and alerted.

items.title: Ticket review dashboard
items.description: Displays all classified tickets, draft replies, and escalated VIP items in a single list view.
items.proved_when: Users can view the list of tickets with their urgency, assigned team, and drafts.
items.source_quote: Classify incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team, draft a reply for simple ones, and escalate anything from VIP

questions.text: Where should VIP ticket escalations be sent?

not_in_this_version.title: Automated ticket closing
not_in_this_version.reason: Not requested; the scope focuses on classification, drafting, and escalation.
